question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
SELECT 
    w1.words as word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w2.words) as anagram_count
FROM word_list w1
JOIN word_list w2 ON w1.words != w2.words
    AND w1.words IS NOT NULL AND w2.words IS NOT NULL
    AND length(w1.words) = length(w2.words)
    AND length(w1.words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND w1.words LIKE 'r%'
    AND (SELECT string_agg(c, '' ORDER BY c)
         FROM (SELECT substring(w1.words, n, 1) as c
               FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, length(w1.words))) as n) t2) t
        ) = (SELECT string_agg(c, '' ORDER BY c)
              FROM (SELECT substring(w2.words, n, 1) as c
                    FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, length(w2.words))) as n) t2) t
             )
GROUP BY w1.words
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT w2.words) >= 1
ORDER BY w1.words
LIMIT 10
